ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black) to 35% high-intensity (white) across the visible surface, characterized by a dark central mass and light outer lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark region extends from the peduncle base to the mid-lobes. Outer lobes transition to white with heavy dark mottling. Left lobe contains three distinct isolated circular black spots in the upper white field. Right lobe shows a more diffuse 'salt-and-pepper' transition at the dark-to-light boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel-based interior angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Distinct peaks and valleys increase in amplitude towards the distal tips, where edge definition is partially obscured by barnacle colonization.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, textured, high-intensity clusters (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, thin, curvilinear white scratch located on the right side of the central dark mass. Multiple shorter, horizontal linear streaks are visible in the upper-left white quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the terminal tips of both fluke lobes; significant linear scar on the right-central fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique triangular arrangement of three medium-sized black spots on the white portion of the left fluke lobe.
